pages.text: Every dragon begins as an egg. The colour of the shell tells you which subspecies laid it.$(br2)An egg can be placed on the ground or set into a $(l:plants_and_items/nest)Dragon Nest$(). Breaking it picks it up again without harm.

pages.title: Dragon Egg
pages.text: Wearing a $(l:plants_and_items/dragon_scale)Dragon Scale$() reveals an egg's subspecies when you look at it.
